 ◢◤ ⇄ Host                                    
 Host interzone's files over IPFS             
                                              
 Help servers set up and update during a      
 blackout: the machine keeps the newest       
 signed copy of what interzone downloads and  
 shares it with interzone's IPFS swarm. It    
 listens on TCP port 4001 (open it in the     
 firewall), and the swarm's members can see   
 that it holds Matrix software.               
                                              
 ▌  ●  Host the container images (about 12    
 ▌     GB)                                    
 ▌     on                                     
 ▌  Host any mix of parts. All four let       
 ▌  other servers set up from scratch         
   ▼ more below                               
                                              
 ✓ hosting. It keeps going without interzone; 
   installing IPFS v0.43.1 (from              
 https://infamous.g0th.ir/.ipfs)              
   the server is downloading about 16.2 GB in 
 the background and shares it as it arrives
